steps.what: Prepare remedial activities from teacher-established learning needs

loop.purpose: Adapt approved activities to a teacher-specified support goal
loop.input: Teacher observations, chosen goal and approved activity sources
loop.output: Draft sequence with simple instructions and goal links
loop.check: Teacher checks the activity actually practises the target skill, suits the child's development and avoids unsupported diagnostic assumptions
loop.stop: One revision then manual planning if suitability remains uncertain
loop.why_not_simpler: Activity banks help but cannot always adapt instructions and progression to a specific teacher-established need

steps.what: Implement remedial programs and adjust support during guided practice

tasks.design: Reuse approved activities in {DOCS}, adding a bounded adaptation draft only for the teacher's chosen support goal. The teacher approves the activity and delivers all remedial practice personally; no model determines the child's need.
tasks.previous_blocker: Adapting familiar activity instructions takes time alongside direct support.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-limited rewriting can assist preparation while retaining suitability checks.
tasks.still_hard: A written activity can be inappropriate for the child's actual response or developmental stage.
tasks.human_edge: Notice whether support is helping and change the interaction immediately.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less activity preparation; support delivery and responsibility remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: LessonUp can rewrite lesson text at another level; this supports drafting assistance, not diagnosis or the effectiveness of a remedial programme.
The reviewed remedial adaptation and time allowances are E1 model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is preparing and delivering remedial activities after needs are identified, excluding formal diagnostic assessment and ordinary class instruction.

The teacher captures the specific observed difficulty, chosen goal, activity source and practical constraints in retained s1 time. All 15 remaining preparation hours include input capture, correction and approval; no structured diagnosis is assumed.
Use native activity banks and templates first. Missing source support or poor developmental fit returns preparation to manual work; no live support time is reduced.
unknowns: Approved support activities and local planning authority
research_questions: Do reviewed drafts reduce preparation without increasing correction or weakening developmental suitability?

already_counted.description: Support-goal capture, draft correction and activity approval

incremental.description: Maintain approved activity guidance and inspect draft errors

approvals.approved_version: Exact activity sequence, target skill, instructions and practical constraints after teacher review; edits require renewed approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=15+75=90; gross 10%, minus three upkeep gives 7% central net. Low assumes four preparation hours removable; all remedial delivery remains full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Identify concerns and discuss them with responsible adults

steps.what: Identify children showing concerning changes through direct observation
Discuss observed concerns with supervisors, parents, guardians or development specialists

tasks.design: Keep observation and sensitive discussion with the teacher and appropriate adults. Existing safeguarding and support guidance in {DOCS} remains available; no child-risk score or emotion inference is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Concerns require context and careful discussion rather than a label from isolated behaviour.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing referral guidance already supports responsible human escalation.
tasks.still_hard: Changes can have several explanations and disclosure must be appropriate.
tasks.human_edge: Describe concrete observations respectfully and recognise when specialist help is needed.
tasks.altitude: Observation, discussion and escalation duties remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Referral thresholds and precise observation language

evidence.claim: Direct concern identification and discussion retain all labour; no automated diagnosis or child scoring is proposed.

assumptions: Boundary is observation and discussion of concerns, excluding specialist diagnosis, remedial delivery and record production assigned elsewhere.
No new structured concern category or model classification is required.
Existing native support guidance suffices. No deployment or additional maintenance is introduced, justifying zero upkeep.
unknowns: School referral procedures and appropriate information-sharing arrangements
research_questions: Are concerns described as concrete observations and shared with the appropriate responsible adult?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; zero gross saving and zero upkeep. Observation and sensitive discussion remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain pupil records and prepare reports

steps.what: Maintain student records with factual observations and completed activities
Prepare required reports from pupil records and teacher observations

loop.purpose: Draft factual comments from teacher-selected record entries
loop.input: Selected dated observations, activity records and report template
loop.output: Draft report with each statement linked to an observation
loop.check: Teacher verifies the child's identity, attribution, context and actual meaning; reject diagnostic labels or unsupported generalisations
loop.stop: One redraft then manual writing if any material statement is unsupported
loop.why_not_simpler: Queries populate fixed fields, but concise comments from varied observations need semantic drafting

steps.what: Verify accuracy, completeness and appropriate disclosure before confirming the report

tasks.design: Use native record and report templates in {OTHER}, the pupil information system, with a bounded draft only for narrative comments. The teacher retains factual observation capture and verifies the exact report before sharing with an authorised recipient.
tasks.previous_blocker: Dated observations must be rewritten into clear report comments.
tasks.enabler_now: Pupil records and native templates can provide sources for a teacher-reviewed draft.
tasks.still_hard: A short comment can misrepresent context or turn an observation into an unsupported label.
tasks.human_edge: Know the child and judge whether the report accurately and fairly describes the evidence.
tasks.altitude: Less report wording; record accuracy and disclosure responsibility stay with the teacher.

reach.task: Maintain reporting requirements and recipient access
reach.learn: Required fields, source dates and disclosure limits

evidence.claim: ParnasSys provides pupil records and learning-goal tracking; this supports the source-record category without establishing automated narrative accuracy.
Source-linked pupil report drafting and its time estimate are E1 model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is factual pupil records and report preparation, excluding live observation already performed in teaching or concern-identification tasks. s1 covers recording and verifying those observations rather than observing the same episode again.

The teacher produces pupil ID, dated factual observation, activity reference, source attribution and relevant context in s1; all 45 hours remain for entry and clarification. The school administrator supplies existing report field and recipient requirements, with added maintenance counted below.

Missing context or source links returns the comment to manual drafting in retained s2 time. Test native reports and comment banks before a bounded loop; no diagnosis, emotion inference or grade decision is generated.
unknowns: Pupil-system access and permitted drafting environment
Local report requirements and data permissions
research_questions: Can every drafted comment be supported by a dated observation without adding labels or losing context?

already_counted.description: Record capture, comment correction and final report verification

incremental.description: Maintain comment guidance and review recurring drafting errors
Maintain report requirements and access settings

approvals.approved_version: Exact pupil, report text, observation references, reporting period and recipient; edits require renewed approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=45+17.5+20=82.5; gross 17.5%, minus four focal upkeep gives 13.5% central net. Low assumes six wording hours removed where observations need substantial clarification; source recording remains full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Select clear lesson, unit and project objectives for the children
Write objectives and child-friendly explanations for planned activities

loop.purpose: Draft simple objective wording from teacher-selected goals
loop.input: Selected goals, activities and intended child-facing explanation
loop.output: Proposed objectives and explanations linked to the selected goals
loop.check: Teacher checks that the wording preserves the actual skill, describes a feasible activity and can be understood by the children
loop.stop: One revision then manual wording if meaning or developmental fit remains wrong
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed goal list helps selection but cannot always express the goal appropriately for the specific activity

steps.what: Communicate objectives to children and check their understanding
outputs: shared understanding of the activity purpose

tasks.design: Start with curriculum-goal lists and reusable wording in {DOCS}; use a bounded draft only to express teacher-selected objectives for a specific activity. The teacher checks the final wording and communicates the purpose directly to children.
tasks.previous_blocker: Formal curriculum wording needs translation into clear activity-specific language.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-limited text adaptation can assist that wording while leaving objective selection human.
tasks.still_hard: Simple words can still change the intended skill or imply an unrealistic outcome.
tasks.human_edge: Connect the purpose to the children's activity and recognise whether they understand it.
tasks.altitude: Less wording work; objective choice and classroom explanation remain unchanged.

reach.task: Align activities with early learning goals
reach.learn: Goal progression and developmentally appropriate language

evidence.claim: LessonUp offers lesson-text rewriting at another level, supporting wording assistance rather than independent objective selection.
The proposed objective adaptation and time estimate are E1 model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is selecting, wording and explaining objectives, excluding subsequent instruction and complete lesson-material production.

The teacher produces goal reference, intended skill, activity context and child-facing purpose in s1; all 35 hours remain. Retained s2 time includes any additional brief entry, semantic correction and approval.
Test native curriculum lists and reusable wording first. Unclear goals return to manual planning; all communication with children stays counted in s3.
unknowns: Existing goal lists and reusable wording
research_questions: Does adapted wording preserve the selected skill and help children understand the activity's purpose?

already_counted.description: Goal capture, wording correction and approval

incremental.description: Maintain approved goal references and wording guidance

approvals.approved_version: Exact objective wording, goal link and child-facing explanation; changes require renewed approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+21+30=86; gross 14%, minus three upkeep gives 11% central net. Low assumes five wording hours removed when substantial revision is required; objective selection and explanation remain full.

role.altitude: Less remedial preparation, report wording and objective drafting while retaining direct support, observation and family conversations.
reach: Work with learning support specialists on suitable activities and referral boundaries
role.ambitious_version: A kindergarten teacher who writes fewer repeated drafts and keeps attention on children's actual needs.
